branch: ops/scout-pending (single accumulating PR, recreated from main after #81 merged)
method: Free sources only, one request each: x.ai/bot/marketplace ItemList (JSON-LD inside the RSC flight payload), six awesome-grokbot catalogues, grokbots.best flight payload (976 records with author + source post), free web_search, and api.fxtwitter.com for post expansion. Zero paid API calls.

verification.reader: ops/tools/share_record_scan.py (authoritative: decodes the RSC flight payload and raw-decodes the share record)
verification.bar: HTTP 200 AND a share record carrying botName + description; the bot name on the record matches the catalogue name
verification.handle_rule: builder handle set only where two independent sources agree on the same share id: the platform share record's sharerName AND the author of the X post carrying that exact share link. All five handle-carrying entries in this pass were corroborated with api.fxtwitter.com, and the post author's display name matches the platform sharer name in every case.

held.spacex_note: xAI's own first-party template library. The platform display name is the org name SpaceX, so there is no community builder to attribute, and listing them invites an xAI-endorsement read. Unchanged policy from the 07:00 and 00:55 passes.

rotation.note: 25 existing listings re-opened live with share_record_scan.py; all 200, all names unchanged. Nothing set pending, nothing delisted.

marketplace.note: The official marketplace now renders an ItemList of 84 curated templates in the RSC flight payload, so it is readable without a browser. It is now public (Sawyer Merritt announced it). It serves its own share alias ids for bots that builders also shared directly (see ops/marketplace-alias-map.json), so match marketplace candidates by NAME, never by URL. The three names not in the directory expose no share link on their marketplace detail page, so they cannot be verified or listed.
